newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL sets April oil pipeline apportionment.
newsitem.headline: IPL sets April oil pipeline apportionment.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc unit Interprovincial Pipe Line said on Friday that April apportionment on its Line 3, which carries mostly heavy and medium crude oils, was set at six percent.

Apportionment, or the volume of oil expected to move on the line subtracted from shipper nominations, jumped from zero percent in March on the 650,000 barrel per day line which runs to Superior, Wisconsin from Edmonton, Alberta.
IPL said it was asking shippers to revise their nominations for Line 3 by Monday to account for the rationing of capacity.
The company said that no rationing of space was required for April on Line 1, which moves mostly natural gas liquids and refined products, or Lines 2 and 13, which carry light and medium crude oils.
Apportionment on those lines was also set at zero for March.
All four adjacent pipelines feed into IPL's Lakehead Pipe Line system at Superior, which carries the Canadian production to refineries in the U.S. Midwest and southern Ontario.
